subject: Clean chain-grain references from model training and serving scripts
description: For the canonical tree identified in task 2: remove bychain path resolution and any chain-grain branch from srq1_benchmark.py, srq1_benchmark_tuned.py, srq1_figures.py, srq1_profiling.py, srq2_synthesis.py, srq4_experiment.py, srq4_tier2.py and model_serving/system_a_forecast/forecast_service.py.
